title: LungDepo: modelling the regional particle deposition in the human lung via the Enalos Cloud platform
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00299K, Paper
Open Access

Dimitris G. Mintis, Dimitra-Danai Varsou, Panagiotis D. Kolokathis, Andreas Tsoumanis, Georgia Melagraki, Johannes P. Seif, Alejandro J. del Real, Iseult Lynch, Antreas Afantitis
LungDepo is a user-friendly web app that supports policy makers, risk assessors, and industry in computing lung deposition of coarse, fine, and ultrafine particles across the head airway, tracheobronchial, and alveolar regions.
